tha-ap300:1.1: Saraṇagamaniya.] Pabbate Himavantamhi ahosiṃ luddako tadā / Vipassim addasaṃ Buddhaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ. // //
tha-ap300:2.1: Upāsitvāna sambuddhaṃ veyyāvaccam akās' ahaṃ / saraṇañ ca upāgacchiṃ dipadindassa tādino. // //
tha-ap300:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe saraṇaṃ yam agacch' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi saraṇāgamanapphalaṃ. // //
tha-ap300:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Saraṇagamaniyo thero i. g. a-ti.
